author: golem
body:
# Resume the already-approved normal-audio preparation

The priority cache correction is qualified through actual ARM mechanism, FSIM Pi/Oryx application and 6502 both-engine recovery gates. Resume the previously authorized FX-067 source review, bounded fake-SDL host checks and new stopped-profile preparation under unchanged FX-068/069 scope. Preserve the unbuilt initial sources and all prior diagnostic evidence. Review callbacks forwarded exactly once, bounded observations, actual library/format discovery, fail-closed normal-driver selection, finite teardown and silent-control topology. Return frozen source/tool/runtime/fixture/profile pins and actual host results, not a readiness claim based solely on intended checks. No queue/clock/mixer/firmware repair is selected.

Generation37 is reserved exclusively for the Author's FSIM human review, lease03a3b5c94299468084ab58a3c41d535b; Wolf/recovery human reviews follow separately. This release permits preparation and device-free host checks only: no audio device open, SDL normal/disk control execution, emulator/library target execution or lease takeover. A stopped new profile may be staged without consuming it. Request a fresh slot when ready and hold; root will schedule after human slots are explicitly released. Keep all existing owner/application profiles, selected shared runtimes, audio services and system settings unchanged.

This continues your existing accepted assignment, not an unrelated task or a request for default promotion/publication. Immediate durable reply plus chat notification remains the communication rule. Tell me promptly if the exact retained baseline cannot be reconstructed; do not silently substitute the newer cache backend into the matched audio pair.
